description: 13 office strata units in Wisma Atria Property (carrying value S$31.9m) divested to unrelated third parties during FY2024/25, reducing the Group's strata title interest in total share value of Wisma Atria to 68.81% (from 74.23%).
gross_sale_price_basis: 'sales consideration of approximately S$41 million' p32; approximate headline figure, distinct from net_proceeds S$40,898,000 (after directly attributable costs). Recovered round7 2026-07-03.
valuation_basis: 'the valuation of approximately S$32 million as at 30 June 2024 by CBRE Pte. Ltd. (income capitalisation method + DCF)' — p32 footnote (8); approximate, deal-specific valuation of the 13 divested strata units (distinct from book carrying value S$31.9m). Recovered round7 2026-07-03.
counterparty: Seven separate, unrelated third-party investors: Dental Designs Clinic Pte. Ltd., Petite Smiles Pte. Ltd., PMWChia Pte. Ltd., Asia Healthcare Group Pte. Ltd., Redbridge Health Pte. Ltd., Platinum Capital 1903 Pte. Ltd., and Singapore Aobo Brilliance Pte. Ltd. (p32 fn8).
gain_on_divestment_basis: vs_valuation (derived, FLAGGED): no premium% disclosed in AR. (sale_price 41,000,000 - valuation 32,000,000)/valuation 32,000,000 = 28.125%. AR frames deal as 'approximately S$41 million, compared to the valuation of approximately S$32 million as at 30 June 2024 by CBRE' (p32 fn8). Alternative vs_book_value using disclosed gain_on_divestment 9,044,000 / carrying_value 31,900,000 = 28.35%; using net_sale_proceeds 40,898,000 - carrying_value 31,900,000 = 8,998,000 / 31,900,000 = 28.21%.
